userStories.title: Project setup: Next.js 15 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + Prisma + Neon
userStories.description: Initialize the Next.js 15 project with App Router, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Prisma ORM connected to Neon PostgreSQL. Setup ESLint, TypeScript strict mode, .env.example, and basic folder structure (app/, components/, lib/, prisma/).
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 15 app runs with `pnpm dev` using Turbopack
Tailwind CSS v4 is configured and working
shadcn/ui is initialized with dark theme defaults
Prisma is configured with Neon DATABASE_URL in .env
TypeScript strict mode enabled
ESLint configured
.gitignore includes node_modules, .next, .env
Folder structure: app/, components/ui/, lib/, prisma/
.env.example with all required env vars documented

userStories.title: Test infrastructure: Vitest + Playwright + DB seed
userStories.description: Setup complete test infrastructure. Vitest for unit/integration tests with Prisma mocking pattern. Playwright for E2E tests with auto-start dev server. Comprehensive Prisma seed script with realistic sample data used by both dev and E2E tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Vitest configured: vitest.config.ts with Node env, globals, path aliases (@/ -> ./src or ./)
Playwright configured: playwright.config.ts with chromium, base URL, auto web server start, screenshots on failure
pnpm test runs Vitest unit tests
pnpm test:e2e runs Playwright E2E tests
Test helper: lib/test-utils.ts with Prisma mock factory (vi.mock pattern from Syndic-Copro)
prisma/seed.ts: idempotent seed script (clears tables first, then creates data)
Seed creates: 15+ events (all departments, all categories, both dates), 3 news articles, 6 partners, 3 pages (festival, inscription, mentions-legales), 1 admin user
pnpm db:seed runs the seed script
Sample E2E test passes: navigate to home page, check title
Sample unit test passes: basic utility function test
